settings.updates.prerelease.confirm.conf: A pre-release can write settings this stable release cannot read back. It may not happen, but if it does, FixLang discards the whole stored configuration on the next stable launch — every profile, preset and API key reference — and reverting does not bring it back. Local history is unaffected. Export your profiles first if you want a copy.
settings.updates.prerelease.confirm.deta: FixLang quits, downloads the pre-release build with Homebrew, and reopens once it is installed. Revert to stable any time from this panel — no confirmation is needed for that direction.
